description.value: The study examined whether plasma biomarkers of alcohol intake—gamma-glutamyl transferase, mean corpuscular volume, and carbohydrate-deficient transferrin—were associated with regional gray-matter and white-matter volumes measured with MRI in 55 male drinkers using multiple linear regression.

spans.text: We related plasma levels of GGT, MCV, and CDT with regional brain gray-matter and white-matter volumes measured with magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) using multiple linear regression in a sample of 55 male drinkers.

description.value: The study was an observational, cross-sectional MRI study of 55 male drinkers recruited from newspaper advertisements; participants were not assigned to intervention arms.

spans.text: From about 800 applications, 55 males of Caucasian descent were selected.
